schema_note: Declarative pins for router-enabled interoperability qualification. Values were observed with `git ls-remote <repo_url> HEAD`; they are source pins, not claims that any router was executed locally.

routers.label: Java I2P

provisioning.install_hint: Install from a release tarball or build with ant/maven per the project README; no single-binary invocation is assumed here.

env.I2P_DIR: SAM bridge configuration lives in ${I2P_DIR}/router.config: sam.enabled=true, sam.port=7656, sam.bind.port=7655

routers.notes: Reference SAM v3 implementation. SAM must be enabled in router.config before the bridge listens. UDP egress is required for the router to join the network.

routers.label: i2pd

provisioning.install_hint: Build the pinned revision with cmake, or install a distribution package whose version matches the pin.

env.I2PD_DATA: Router data directory; the SAM bridge is enabled by CLI flags above, not by an environment variable.

routers.notes: Second independent implementation. i2pd retains the MASTER spelling for SAM 3.3 shared sessions; shared dialect selection stays explicit.

routers.label: i2pr

provisioning.install_hint: Build the pinned revision of the i2pr router from its own repository with cargo.

env.I2PR_CONFIG: SAM bridge listen address/port for the i2pr router; confirm the exact key against the pinned revision before use.

routers.notes: The i2pr router is a separate upstream project from this client library. This harness only ever qualifies it through its own SAM bridge on the configured endpoint; it never claims the router was run from inside this repository.
